end.summary:
- Explored cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
- Practised identifying a cylinder by its two flat circular faces and curved side.
- Aditya initially said a cylinder becomes a roller when turned or laid down.
- Aditya later stated that a turned cylinder still has two flat faces; they also corrected the cone example.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming 3D shapes in toys, especially identifying a cylinder by its two circular flat faces and curved side. Aditya used tracing and repeated the feature count; their mix-up about a shape changing its name when turned was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask them to find a can, box, ball, and party hat, then name each shape in different positions.
